phase: DEV-245 River Development Agent Controlled Execution Intelligence Governance Execution Handoff Foundation
commitMessage: DEV-245: Build River Development Agent controlled execution intelligence governance execution handoff foundation
architectureStatus: Generation III governance execution handoff-readiness foundation
predecessor: DEV-244 River Development Agent controlled execution intelligence governance execution dispatch foundation
objective: Create a deterministic controlled execution intelligence governance execution-handoff foundation that consumes trusted dispatch-ready DEV-244 governance execution-dispatch records and produces structured governed execution-handoff records while preserving dispatch provenance, governed execution-request evidence, human authorization evidence, repository authorization evidence, explicit approval evidence, approved execution scope, and strict separation between execution handoff readiness and actual command or repository execution.
architecturalDecision: DEV-244 establishes governed dispatch readiness without performing execution.
DEV-245 introduces an explicit controlled handoff boundary before any future executor may be considered.
Execution handoff records describe eligibility for a downstream executor but do not themselves execute commands.
Execution handoff cannot create new authorization, approval, repository modification, commit, push, deployment, or scope-expansion authority.
Any actual executor remains a separately governed downstream phase.
invariants: Handoff requires trusted DEV-244 execution-dispatch evidence.
Handoff requires an unblocked DEV-244 dispatch record.
Handoff fails closed when any predecessor requirement fails.
Handoff cannot expand approved execution scope.
Handoff readiness remains separate from actual command execution.
Handoff readiness remains separate from repository modification.
Handoff readiness does not grant commit authority.
Handoff readiness does not grant push authority.
Handoff readiness does not grant deployment authority.
Handoff readiness grants no autonomous execution authority.
